title: Billy Braun's military band and straight music
summary: Braun's band played marches and sentimental music, not ragged, though Laine says Braun could have made it a good ragtime band.

story.theme_name: Who was in the band: naming sidemen and personnel
story.community_name: Who played in the band: reciting personnel

blocks.x: Well, what did Billy Braun's band play like? Ask him what Braun's. Braun? Yeah.
Military stuff. Oh. Marches? Marches and stuff like that.
But they did not rag those marches? No.
No. Sentimental music. All straight stuff.
But Braun was a musician. I want to tell you that. He could turn his band into a good ragtime band because he knew his business.
